title: On solid angles and simplex shape measures
summary: The minimum solid angle of a simplex is shown to be a shape measure in any dimension. While this has been known in dimensions two and three, the higher-dimensional generalization is new. We prove inequalities between the minimum solid angle of a non-degenerate simplex and its fullness. Up to dimension-dependent constants, the fullness is bounded from above by the minimum solid angle and from below by the square of the minimum solid angle.
